entities.name: Tempé
entities.description: A planeswalker, manipulative and ruthless, who marooned her sangrazul servant Malvos on Cridhe.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Tempé's sangrazul servant, marooned on Cridhe.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: Plane where Malvos was marooned, leading to a Dark Age.

entities.name: the Thorn
entities.description: Rival of Tempé from whom she won the sword Soulslayer; may have the upper hand.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: Sword Tempé won from the Thorn in a duel.

events.summary: Tempé marooned Malvos on Cridhe, indirectly causing a Dark Age.
events.quote: marooned her sangrazul servant Malvos on the plane of Cridhe

events.summary: Tempé wins the sword Soulslayer from the Thorn in a duel.
events.quote: from whom she won the sword Soulslayer in a duel

relations.quote: most notably a figure known as the Thorn
